## History

Lorenzo White had seven daughters before the arrival of his first son. Overjoyed by the birth of his new baby boy, he was strategically visited by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during his celebration. As a result of his happiness, he generously contributed a five-dollar donation to her subscription canvassing.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_
